Complete printed proof of Theorem(1.1), including Lemmas1.6/1.8/1.10 and Proposition1.11, pp.810–813; text225–518
verification_scope: A proper holomorphic submersion with compact Kähler fibres over a small polydisc has a holomorphic Hodge-filtration period map in the locally constant marking. The locally simultaneous minimal elliptic pullbacks in B6.12 are smooth projective surfaces and therefore satisfy these hypotheses. Their finite deck characters define holomorphic eigensubbundles. Nonconstant period maps and exclusion of rational Hodge loci then use the separately computed hyperbolic monodromy and signatures.
limits: The theorem proves holomorphic variation; the nonconstancy and exact Mordell–Weil norm image are receiving results. The printed proof imports the Kuranishi analytic-coordinate lemma; no independent reproof of Kuranishi theory is asserted.

verification_scope: F3.4 explicitly assumes an algebraic polarized abelian-surface family. Its smooth proper algebraic cohomology is an algebraic Hodge family under Definition4.2.4/Proposition4.2.5, so Theorem4.2.6 gives a semisimple rational monodromy representation. The invariant summand splits globally; N_W has kernel=image of dimension2 and vanishes on that summand, which forces it to be zero. This global algebraic hypothesis is essential.
limits: This is HodgeII1971, not HodgeIII1974 or the1970 regular-connections book. No claim of semisimplicity for an arbitrary punctured-disc unipotent local system is made.

opened_locators: Exact author version3,7May2002; Definition1.1, Theorem1.2 and Example1, printed p.3; text90–132
verification_scope: The frame bundle over the open Riemann surface is a holomorphic submersion over a Stein base with fibre GL(n,C). Its global vertical spray is (g,A)→g exp(A), and its derivative is onto the vertical tangent. A complex bundle over a graph has a continuous frame because GL(n,C) is connected. Theorem1.2 deforms that section to a holomorphic frame, which is the only use in F3.10.
limits: The precise opened-v3 locator is p.3, correcting the source bibliography’s p.2. The theorem is not applied to the noncompact period domain or to an unsupported relative puncture constraint.
